summary: Implemented the 630 Lambda transform in the MONAI repo. Added `Lambda` to monai/transforms/utility/array.py (wraps a callable; raises TypeError if not callable) and `Lambdad` to monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py (applies func to each key; func may be one callable or one per key; returns a new dict). Added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. I did not update docs/source/transforms.rst or CHANGELOG.md; the new classes rely on their docstrings for documentation.
